name: walking backward on a treadmill
description: Walking backwards at a gentle pace on a treadmill. It works the quads and gets your heart rate up in a joint-friendly way.
instructions: Set the treadmill to a very slow speed and hold the handrails.
Turn to face away from the direction of the belt.
Step back gently, landing on the toes first.
Keep your chest tall and take small steps.
Continue for several minutes at a comfortable pace.
